title: Theoretically exploring selective-binding mechanisms of BRD4 through integrative computational approaches.
authors: Luo, D; Tong, J B; Xiao, X C; Bian, S; Zhang, X; Wang, J; Xu, H Y
journal: SAR and QSAR in environmental research
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算手段研究BRD4蛋白与小分子抑制剂的结合机制，属于蛋白-配体互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The origin of cancer is related to the dysregulation of multiple signal pathways and of physiological processes. Bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) has become an attractive target for the development of anticancer and anti-inflammatory agents since it can epigenetically regulate the transcription of growth-promoting genes. The synthesized BRD4 inhibitors with new chemical structures can reduce the drug resistance, but their binding modes and the inhibitory mechanism remain unclear. Here, we initially constructed robust QSAR models based on 68 reported tetrahydropteridin analogues using topomer CoMFA and HQSAR. On the basis of QSAR results, we designed 16 novel tetrahydropteridin analogues with modified structures and carried out docking studies. Instead of significant hydrogen bondings with amino acid residue Asn140 as reported in previous research, the molecular docking modelling suggested a novel docking pose that involves the amino acid residues (Trp81, Pro82, Val87, Leu92, Leu94, Cys136, Asp144, and Ile146) at the active site of BRD4. The MD simulations, free energy calculations, and residual energy contributions all indicate that hydrophobic interactions are decisive factors affecting bindings between inhibitors and BRD4. The current study provides new insights that can aid the discovery of BRD4 inhibitors with enhanced anti-cancer ability.
abstract_zh: 癌症的起源与多条信号通路及生理过程的失调相关。含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）已成为开发抗癌和抗炎药物的重要靶点，因为它能够通过表观遗传调控促进生长基因的转录。具有新化学结构的合成BRD4抑制剂可以降低药物耐药性，但其结合模式及抑制机制仍不清楚。在此，我们首先基于68种已报道的四氢蝶啶类似物，利用topomer CoMFA和HQSAR方法构建了稳健的QSAR模型。基于QSAR结果，我们设计了16种结构修饰的新型四氢蝶啶类似物，并进行了对接研究。与先前研究中报道的与氨基酸残基Asn140形成显著氢键不同，分子对接模型提出了一种新的对接姿态，涉及BRD4活性位点的氨基酸残基（Trp81、Pro82、Val87、Leu92、Leu94、Cys136、Asp144和Ile146）。分子动力学模拟、自由能计算及残基能量贡献均表明，疏水相互作用是影响抑制剂与BRD4结合的决定性因素。本研究提供了新见解，有助于发现具有增强抗癌能力的BRD4抑制剂。
